bullets: On Tuesday 13 October, DLD recorded 523 sales worth AED 1.4bn, which is 12.5% above a typical weekday.
Off-plan properties made up 70.9% of sales, compared to a 7-day average of 61.2%.
The median price was AED 1,689 per sq ft, up 2.5% from the 30-day average and down 0.2% from last year.
Over the past 7 days, the busiest areas were JVC with 192 sales, Dubai South with 191 sales, and Downtown Jebel Ali with 151 sales.
In September new rental contracts for a JVC 1-bedroom apartment had a median of AED 69,000 a year, rising 3.2% on the month.
talking_points: New Dubai shared housing rules have been introduced that may increase low-income costs and impact rental supply standards.
A complete guide on applying for a UAE Golden Visa is now available, which directly influences investor decisions and long-term property commitments.
Dubai has unveiled a massive infrastructure and housing project pipeline that will heavily shape future market dynamics and investor sentiment.
